title: The 30 September Movement tries to seize power in Indonesia
summary: Army officers calling themselves the 30 September Movement killed six generals in Jakarta. General Suharto crushed them and blamed the Communist Party.
reason: Tensions between the army and the Communist Party under Sukarno's rule had reached a crisis.
significance: It led to mass killings of perhaps 500,000 people and Suharto's three decades of rule.
